text: The run is red. The only saved output says test failed; there is no assertion or provisioning log.
A new parser consistently drops the final field of the provided sample on every rerun; the old parser preserves it.
The container registry returns 503 before the test image is downloaded. No application tests execute.
Same commit, inputs and isolated runner configuration: this timing assertion fails twice and passes three times; dependencies report healthy.
The runner disk fills while installing packages, before the application starts.
Across three clean runs, cart.total returns 8 while the documented expected result is 10. Provisioning and dependencies are healthy.
One assertion failed during a period of network errors, but it is not known whether the test depends on that network.
An unchanged unit test alternates success and timeout across five immediate runs on the same healthy runner.
